content_zh:
龙国篇龙国篇第九章龙国之旅
“龙国的灭亡不仅仅是跟不上时代的脚步，其实其中暗藏着许多玄机。”
“若论龙国的国力，其实龙国曾经也统治过所有大陆，后来因为一些什么事情，所以之后的龙国就再也没有再次统治所有大陆了”
“至于为什么如此强大无比的国家，最后确在二百年前彻底灭亡，关于这个传闻也同样引来了一大批人前来揭穿迷题”
“可最后得出的结果十种百种让人不敢相信那个真那个是假，至今依旧是迷”
艾米的话语中充满了不解与惋惜，她的眼神仿佛穿透了千年的时光，直视着那个遥远而悲壮的时代。
正当思绪万千之际，天际忽变，风起云涌，仿佛连自然之力也为之动容。
叶恒猛然抬头，目光穿透了厚重的云层，惊呼声脱口而出：“快看！
天际之端，有龙翱翔！”
艾米与另一位同伴闻言，皆是面色骤变，眼中闪过难以置信的光芒，异口同声地低呼：“什么？龙？”
只见那头巨龙，身形庞大无匹，估摸着约有三十余丈长，其背生双翼，宽展如云，遮天蔽日。
最令人震撼的，莫过于那前爪与龙头，雕琢般的轮廓中蕴含着无尽威严，每一片龙鳞都仿佛承载着岁月的重量，闪烁着冷冽而神秘的光芒。
巨龙仰天长啸，其声穿云裂石，震得四周空气都为之颤抖，那一刻，时间仿佛凝固，万物皆为之失色。
叶恒的目光中闪烁着不解与惊异，他轻声却带着几分不可思议地向艾米问道：“艾米姐，据我所知，龙国的故事在尘封的历史长河中，不是早已伴随着岁月的流转而消逝了吗？为何时至今日，这世间竟还能窥见龙的踪迹？”
艾米闻言，秀眉微蹙，似乎对这番言论感到意外，她轻捂双耳，仿佛想隔绝这突如其来的疑问带来的冲击，口中喃喃：“你说什么？龙……竟还存在于世？”
艾希：“这背后，定藏着无数未解之谜，如同迷雾中的宝藏，等待着我们去一一揭开。
姐姐，不如我们即刻启程，追随着那龙影，深入探寻这古老而又神秘的真相吧？”
艾米闻言，目光变得坚定，她轻轻点头.
巨龙震耳欲聋的咆哮之后，振翅高飞，其庞大的身影如同乌云般迅速向东北天际掠去，直至化作天边一抹难以捕捉的残影，彻底消失在众人惊异的目光之中。
艾米怔怔地望着巨龙离去的方向，心中涌起一股难以言喻的奇异感，仿佛某种未知的线索悄然织入命运的织锦。

她迅速从腰间抽出那张泛黄的地图，指尖轻轻摩挲过每一寸熟悉的纹路，目光在错综复杂的路线间跳跃，最终定格在巨龙消失的方向上。
那一刻，她的瞳孔猛地一缩，脸上写满了难以置信。
“什么？这……这怎么可能？”
艾米的声音里夹杂着一丝颤抖，她难以置信地低语，“那巨龙所选择的路径，竟与我们此行既定的目的地不谋而合，这背后究竟隐藏着怎样的玄机？”
思绪如潮水般翻涌，龙国的古老传说、未解之谜，以及眼前这突如其来的巧合，在艾米心中交织成一张错综复杂的网。
她深吸一口气，试图平复内心的波澜，随即想起了背包中那台珍贵的无限情报器——那是她与外界联系的桥梁，也是解开谜团的关键。
没有丝毫犹豫，艾米迅速取出情报器，指尖在键盘上跳跃，将这一连串的惊人发现，连同自己心中的疑惑与猜测，一字一句地编织成信息，发送给了远方的总部。
信息发送完毕，她轻轻合上情报器，目光再次投向巨龙离去的方向，眼中闪烁着坚定与好奇的光芒。
“龙国的秘密，似乎正以一种不可思议的方式，缓缓向我揭开它的面纱。”
艾米心中暗道，随即整理好心情，踏上了继续探索的征途，但正是这些未知，让这场旅程充满了无尽的魅力与可能。
他们步伐速度之快仅靠半天便穿越了三个城市，其实还是得靠艾米的承载工具“神剑号”
，此小型飞船可达560000kmh，并且它还有一个功能就是启动前可达无音且启动快，启动瞬吸间可一秒瞬间移动十公里外。
整个武神国仅此三架，可想而知，本行动是有多么机密。
先是从新边市——龙尾市——龙骨市——最后到龙华市。
至于为什么停在了龙华市，还是那神秘古龙在这就无了痕迹。
他们在龙华市一路走走停停，直至夜幕低垂，星辰隐现还是一点线索都无，三人不约而同地停下了脚步，彼此间交换了一个无需言语便能理解的眼神。
空气中弥漫着一种微妙的沉寂，是疲惫，也是不甘。
随着他们一步步深入龙华市正中心时，空气中还弥漫着诡异能量，并且能量波动还愈发强烈。
就在这时，一阵突如其来的爆炸声划破夜的寂静，犹如深渊中的雷鸣，不仅震动了大地，也再次激发了三人内心深处的警觉。
那声音，既是战斗的号角，也是前行的动力，让他们不得不再次振奋精神，踏上征途。
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Arc Dragon Kingdom Arc Chapter 9 Journey to Dragon Kingdom
"The demise of the Dragon Kingdom is not just about failing to keep up with the times. In fact, there are many mysteries hidden in it."
"When it comes to the national power of the Dragon Kingdom, in fact, the Dragon Kingdom once ruled all the continents. Later, due to some things, the Dragon Kingdom never ruled the entire continent again."
"As for why such an extremely powerful country finally perished completely two hundred years ago, this rumor also attracted a large number of people to come to debunk the mystery."
"But there are hundreds of different results that people can't believe which one is true and which one is false. It's still a mystery to this day."
Amy's words were full of confusion and regret, and her eyes seemed to have penetrated thousands of years, looking directly at that distant and tragic era.
Just as he was thinking a lot, the sky suddenly changed and the wind and clouds surged, as if even the force of nature was moved by it.
Ye Heng suddenly raised his head, his eyes penetrated the thick clouds, and blurted out in surprise: "Look!
At the end of the sky, there is a dragon flying! "
When Amy and another companion heard this, their expressions suddenly changed, their eyes flashed with incredible light, and they whispered in unison: "What? Dragon?"
I saw that giant dragon, which was huge and estimated to be about thirty feet long. It had two wings on its back, as wide as clouds, covering the sky and the sun.
The most shocking thing is the front paws and dragon head. The carved outline contains endless majesty. Each dragon scale seems to carry the weight of time, shining with a cold and mysterious light.
The giant dragon raised its head to the sky and roared, its sound penetrated the clouds and cracked the rocks, making the air around it tremble. At that moment, time seemed to have frozen, and everything was eclipsed.
Ye Heng's eyes flashed with confusion and surprise, and he asked Amy softly but somewhat incredulously: "Sister Amy, as far as I know, haven't the stories of the Dragon Kingdom already disappeared with the passage of time in the dusty history? Why can we still see traces of dragons in this world to this day?"
Amy frowned slightly when she heard the words, as if she was surprised by these remarks. She covered her ears lightly, as if to isolate the impact of this sudden question, and murmured: "What did you say? Dragons... still exist in the world?"
Ashe: "Behind this, there must be countless unsolved mysteries, like treasures in the fog, waiting for us to uncover them one by one.
Sister, why don't we set off immediately, follow the dragon shadow, and explore this ancient and mysterious truth? "
When Amy heard this, her eyes became firm, and she nodded slightly.
After the dragon roared deafeningly, it flapped its wings and flew high. Its huge figure quickly swept towards the northeastern sky like a dark cloud, until it turned into an afterimage that was difficult to capture on the horizon and completely disappeared in the astonished eyes of everyone.
Amy stared blankly at the direction in which the dragon was leaving, feeling an indescribable strange feeling in her heart, as if some unknown clue was quietly woven into the tapestry of fate.
She quickly pulled out the yellowed map from her waist, and her fingertips gently touched every inch of the familiar lines. Her eyes jumped between the intricate routes, and finally settled on the direction where the dragon disappeared.
At that moment, her pupils shrank suddenly, and her face was filled with disbelief.
"What? This...how is this possible?"
Amy's voice was mixed with a tremor, and she whispered in disbelief, "The path chosen by the dragon actually coincides with our planned destination. What kind of mystery is hidden behind it?"
Thoughts surged like a tide. The ancient legends of the Dragon Kingdom, unsolved mysteries, and the sudden coincidence before her eyes intertwined into an intricate web in Amy's mind.
She took a deep breath, trying to calm her inner turmoil, and then remembered the precious infinite intelligence device in her backpack - it was the bridge between her and the outside world and the key to solving the mystery.
Without any hesitation, Amy quickly took out the intelligence device, her fingertips jumped on the keyboard,This series of astonishing discoveries, together with the doubts and speculations in his heart, were woven into a message word by word and sent to the distant headquarters.
After sending the message, she gently closed the intelligence device and looked towards the direction where the dragon left again, her eyes shining with determination and curiosity.
"The secret of the Dragon Kingdom seems to be slowly unveiling its veil to me in an incredible way."
Amy secretly thought to herself, and then she straightened her mood and embarked on a journey of continued exploration, but it was these unknowns that made this journey full of endless charm and possibility.
They were so fast that they traveled through three cities in just half a day. In fact, they still had to rely on Amy's carrying vehicle "Excalibur"
, this small spacecraft can reach 560,000kmh, and it also has the function of being silent before starting and starting quickly. It can instantly move ten kilometers away in one second after starting.
There are only three of them in the entire Martial God Kingdom. You can imagine how secret this operation is.
First from Xinbian City - Longwei City - Longgu City - and finally to Longhua City.
As for why it stopped in Longhua City, there was still no trace of the mysterious ancient dragon here.
They walked and stopped all the way in Longhua City, until night fell and the stars loomed, but there was still no clue. The three of them stopped at the same time and exchanged a look that could be understood without words.
There was a subtle silence in the air, one of exhaustion and unwillingness.
As they stepped deeper into the center of Longhua City, the air was still filled with strange energy, and the energy fluctuations became more intense.
At this moment, a sudden explosion broke through the silence of the night, like thunder in the abyss. It not only shook the earth, but also once again aroused the vigilance deep in the three people's hearts.
That voice was both a battle call and a motivation to move forward, forcing them to cheer up again and embark on the journey.
